job_name.description: Task name used in result filenames.
job_name.title: Job Name

protein_fasta_path.description: Protein FASTA path. Provide exactly one of this field and protein_sequence.
protein_fasta_path.title: Protein Fasta Path

protein_sequence.description: Raw protein sequence. Whitespace is removed and the sequence is written to a FASTA file before inference. Provide exactly one of this field and protein_fasta_path.
protein_sequence.title: Protein Sequence

protein_id.description: Optional FASTA record ID used with protein_sequence.
protein_id.title: Protein Id

ligand_csv_path.description: CSV containing ligand SMILES and an optional compound ID column.
ligand_csv_path.title: Ligand Csv Path

ligand_id_column.description: Compound ID column; auto-detected when omitted.
ligand_id_column.title: Ligand Id Column

max_ligands.description: Use only the first N rows for an explicit smoke test.
max_ligands.title: Max Ligands

prepare_only.description: Generate YAML inputs without model inference.
prepare_only.title: Prepare Only
